title: Add 1-based page/per_page parameters to the products API

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Mobile clients want page-based pagination (?page=&per_page=) for GET /products. Legacy clients use ?offset=&limit= and must keep working.
constraints: Responses for requests without pagination parameters must not change.
Legacy offset/limit parameters keep their meaning.
input.context: Product listing API (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). listProducts() maps query parameters onto a generic paginate(items, offset, limit) helper.

ground_truth.material_issue: Offset is computed as page * perPage instead of (page - 1) * perPage: page 1 (and the default request) skips the first 20 products. Existing test 'returns the first 20 products by default' fails.
required_observations: Default request now skips the first page / existing test fails
